groups.name: Content and theme
groups.blurb: What the site is built from.

groups.name: Site identity
groups.blurb: Used for canonical links, social cards and structured data.

groups.name: Routing and entities
groups.blurb: How pages map to layouts, and which become registry entities.

groups.name: Runes and plugins
groups.blurb: Which runes exist, and which package wins when names collide.

groups.name: Content sources
groups.blurb: Where source links and file-reading runes resolve from.

fields.name: contentDir
fields.description: Path to the content directory, relative to the project root. Required for a site to load.

fields.name: theme
fields.description: Active theme — accepts a package name string (legacy shorthand) or a full SiteThemeConfig with presets, token overrides, mode overlays, and code-block colour scheme.

fields.name: target
fields.description: Documentation-only adapter hint (svelte, astro, next, nuxt, eleventy, html). No adapter validates or reads this field today; it serves as an in-config record of the intended adapter. Slated for removal in v1.0.

fields.name: baseUrl
fields.description: Public base URL of the site, used for canonical links, `og:url` and `og:image`.

fields.name: siteName
fields.description: Human-readable site name, used for `og:site_name` and Organization JSON-LD.

fields.name: logo
fields.description: Site logo path used in Organization JSON-LD (e.g. `/favicon-192.png`).

fields.name: defaultImage
fields.description: Default `og:image` for pages that do not set their own. 1200×630 is recommended.

fields.name: routeRules
fields.description: Route-to-layout mapping rules, evaluated in order — first match wins. A rule may also set `entity`, registering matching pages as registry entities of that type (e.g. `runes/**` → `rune`) without per-page frontmatter.

fields.name: entityRoutes
fields.description: Declarative entity → page routes. Each rule generates one page per registered entity matching `type` plus an optional `filter` — the built-in alternative to writing a `contributePages` pipeline hook by hand.

fields.name: plugins
fields.description: Plugins to merge into this site's ThemeConfig (runes, layouts, hooks, etc.).

fields.name: runes
fields.description: Rune resolution — which package wins when several define the same rune name, extra tag names for existing runes, and runes loaded from local files.

fields.name: overrides
fields.description: Component overrides, mapping a `typeof` name to a component path relative to the project root.

fields.name: icons
fields.description: Custom icon SVGs, merged into the theme's global icon group and referenced by name.

fields.name: tints
fields.description: Project-level tint presets, available to any page or rune via the `tint` attribute.

fields.name: backgrounds
fields.description: Named bg presets (keyed by name). Each is a BgPresetDefinition: `style` and/or token-driven `gradient` (engine-resolved), `extends` a base preset, and/or `sandbox` ({ src, framework?, dependencies? }) for a live sandbox backdrop resolved at transform time (SPEC-104). `sandbox` presets are project-level content.

fields.name: highlight
fields.description: Legacy syntax-highlighting configuration — picks a Shiki built-in theme by name (or a `{ light, dark }` pair) for fenced code blocks. The recommended modern approach is `theme.presets` (which contribute `--rf-syntax-*` token overrides via Lumina syntax presets like `@refrakt-md/lumina/presets/nord`) plus `theme.code.colorScheme` for forced light/dark code blocks. Kept for back-compat; both mechanisms can coexist.

fields.name: sandbox
fields.description: Sandbox configuration — the runtime program-source directory scanned at build time (SPEC-104, ADR-022).

fields.name: search
fields.description: Whether to render the site-wide search UI (header button + Cmd/Ctrl+K dialog, powered by Pagefind). Defaults to true. Set false to omit the search chrome entirely. Results require a Pagefind index built and served at /pagefind/ — see the Setting up search guide.

fields.name: repoUrl
fields.description: Canonical GitHub (or compatible) repository URL — e.g. `https://github.com/owner/repo`. Used by the `file-ref` rune (SPEC-078) to build deep-link `View source on GitHub →` URLs of the form `{repoUrl}/blob/{repoBranch}/{path}#L{start}-L{end}`. When absent, `file-ref` falls back to a no-href link / in-page anchor with a build warning.

fields.name: repoBranch
fields.description: Git ref appended to GitHub source URLs — accepts any branch name, tag, or commit SHA. Defaults to `main` when omitted. Use a commit SHA for archival URLs that won't drift when the file is edited later.

fields.name: locale
fields.description: Active locale (BCP 47, e.g. `de`). Selects first-party and plugin translation bundles for framework-generated UI text and drives locale-aware date/number formatting. Defaults to `en`.

fields.name: strings
fields.description: Site-level translation overrides for framework-generated UI text, keyed by the auto-derived i18n key (`{scope}.{block}.{ref}`). Highest precedence — these win over first-party and plugin bundles. Each value is a string, or a map of CLDR plural categories (`one`, `other`, …) to strings.
